description: This file defines an interface MessageRateLimiterBehavior in Java, which provides behavior and utilities for rate limiting message processing in an Akka actor context. It includes methods for starting/stopping message consumers, managing rate limiter state, and handling message acknowledgments.

classes.name: MessageRateLimiterBehavior
classes.description: An interface providing rate limiting behavior for messaging actors in an AMQP context, handling message flow control, rate limiter initialization, and message acknowledgment processing.

classes.name: MessageRateLimiter
classes.description: A class managing rate limiting state and metrics for message processing.

classes.name: AckStatus
classes.description: A class representing acknowledgment status of messages, indicating success or failure and whether redelivery is requested.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: An enum for scheduling control actions, such as checking the rate limit periodically.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the logger instance for the actor.

methods.name: startMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Starts message consumption when rate limits allow.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Stops message consumption with a specified reason, invoked when rate limits are exceeded.

methods.name: getMessageRateLimiter
methods.description: Returns the current rate limiter instance managing rate state.

methods.name: initMessageRateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and initializes the rate limiter based on AMQP configuration, scheduling periodic checks if enabled.

methods.name: getRateLimiterBehavior
methods.description: Provides the message receiving behavior for the actor, including match cases for handling acknowledgment status, control messages, and redeliveries.

methods.name: recordIncomingForRateLimit
methods.description: Records an incoming message's ID for rate limiting, updating in-flight and redelivery counts.

methods.name: recordAckForRateLimit
methods.description: Records acknowledgment of a message, possibly triggering redelivery or terminal acknowledgment.

methods.name: checkRateLimitForConsumedThisPeriod
methods.description: Checks whether the max messages per period are exceeded and stops the consumer if so.

methods.name: checkRateLimitAsScheduled
methods.description: Scheduled method to periodically update and enforce rate limits, starting or stopping consumers as needed.

methods.name: startConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Enables message consumption after rate limit allows it, logging the action.

methods.name: stopConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Disables message consumption due to rate limits being exceeded, with an explanation.

methods.name: logRateLimiter
methods.description: Logs the current state of the rate limiter when starting or stopping the consumer.

methods.name: checkAckStatus
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment results, updating rate limiter state and scheduling redelivery if needed.

methods.name: scheduleForgettingPendingRedelivery
methods.description: Sets a timer to remove pending redelivery status for a message after a timeout.

methods.name: forgetPendingRedelivery
methods.description: Removes message from pending redelivery tracking.

methods.name: getMessageConsumerStoppedReason
methods.description: Generates a reason string based on rate limit violations for stopping the consumer.
